_note: Which cards appear on the site. Written by hand after looking at the exported gallery, then processed by scripts/prepare_site_assets.py. Every src is a path inside an eval_gallery directory. crop is optional and takes four fractions of the image, left top right bottom, used to take marketplace mockup framing off the listing cards. Run the script with --list to see what is available. Source gallery for this pass: eval_gallery_2026-08-30, run_tag run_20260805_0236, 40 cards per condition. Every card below was opened and looked at before it went in.
_hero: One card, shown large in the first screen. Pick something that looks like a card somebody would send rather than the highest scoring one.
_examples: One card per condition, same occasion across the row if possible, so the naive prompt sits next to the pipeline and the marketplace listing. Order here is the order on the page. All four are birthday/general. The hero card is deliberately repeated here so the visitor learns which condition produced the card they were shown first.
_quiz: Half generated, half marketplace listings, shuffled by the page rather than here. Only the 736x1030 greetings_island listings are eligible: the 750x1000 redbubble images carry a seller watermark across the middle that no crop can remove, so they are all excluded. None of the six below needs a crop. note is one line shown after the guess.
